comparison.objective: Extract a connector terminal; record opens a locker and recovers a leaning case upright.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine blade insertion and coordinated withdrawal versus door manipulation, continuous case support, reorientation, transport, and upright placement without tipping or dropping.
comparison.success_condition: Selective undamaged terminal removal versus case released upright on the mat with whole-trial tilt and downward-speed limits respected. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The record tests support and recovery of an unstable load, not retained-component release.
